TEXT:
Having graduated from university, Kyou-chan and I 
got married soon after.

Marriage didn't change our relationship much, with 
the ordinary and happy days passing us by.
Kyou-chan goes to work, while I tend the home.

We're nothing more than just your average 
married couple.

However, maintaining this average, simple, happy 
life might just be the most difficult thing we could 
do.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Nao-chan, those are mommy's underwear. Be good 
and give them back.

SPEAKER: SPK_NAO
TEXT: No way! This underwear is mine!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Ah, wait up~

SPEAKER: SPK_MIO
TEXT: Mommy, is there anything I can help with?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Thank you, Mio-chan. There's nothing for now, you 
can go off and play.

SPEAKER: SPK_MIO
TEXT: Okay, I'll go play over there.

SPEAKER: SPK_NAO
TEXT: Kyahahaha~! Underwear! Underwear!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I'm back~

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Kyou-chan, help me~!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What's wrong? Is it Mio and Nao?!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Mio-chan is fine, but Nao-chan...

SPEAKER: SPK_NAO
TEXT: Welcome back, Dad!

SPEAKER: SPK_MIO
TEXT: Welcome home, Daddy!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Nao, what are you holding?

SPEAKER: SPK_NAO
TEXT: Amazing isn't it? This is my underwear!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Don't lie. Those are Mommy's, right? You are too 
young for this. Confiscated.

Kyou-chan nonchalantly helps me get my 
underwear back.

SPEAKER: SPK_NAO
TEXT: No~!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Geez, who does Nao take after, anyway?

SPEAKER: SPK_MIO
TEXT: Daddy! Daddy! Am I cute?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Ah, those are my glasses. When did she...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Hahaha, you look just like Manami did when she 
was younger.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Ugh... Stop laughing and help me get them off of 
her before something bad happens.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Hey, Mio. It's dangerous to play with glasses, you 
should stop.

SPEAKER: SPK_MIO
TEXT: That's mine~~

Eager to get the glasses back, the twins are 
jumping around Kyou-chan.

SPEAKER: SPK_NAO
TEXT: Give me back my underwear!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Nope.

SPEAKER: SPK_MIO
TEXT: My glasses~~

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: No. Way.

SPEAKER: SPK_BOTH
TEXT: Muuuuuu~!

We get caught up in the whirlwind of our new 
family members' shenanigans on a daily basis.

They certainly are little rascals, but we wouldn't 
trade them for anything in the world.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Hey, Kyou-chan. Are you... happy?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Of course. I have you and our two adorable 
daughters.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Hehe. I wonder if you'll cry when they get married.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: No way! No other man can have my daughters!

It's a different kind of happiness compared to our 
time spent together, new and warm.

Please let this happiness continue on forever and 
ever...
